name: Experience the A$RAM cinematic prelude and enter the world
description: Verifies a mobile visitor receives the cinematic sequence, reaches the portal, and can enter the artist world without horizontal overflow.
steps: Observe the automatic era/title sequence or use SKIP
At the A$RAM portal select ENTER
expected: The prelude resolves into the portal, ENTER reveals the site, and the page remains contained within the mobile viewport.

name: Travel through the complete A$RAM sequence
description: Verifies the updated chronology and exact visible release titles.
steps: Scroll through Danse final. and OLD ME
Verify DE(PRESSED), IN(JUSTICE), INTER(LUDE), GREEN(PLUG), OVER(VIEW), SECRET(MOVE)
expected: The site shows Danse final., the six exact OLD ME titles, PILLS with WEIRD AS DUCK and WILD, then SPECTRAL.

name: Keep SPECTRAL contained on mobile
description: Verifies the large SPECTRAL treatment stays visually contained on a narrow screen.
steps: Inspect the main SPECTRAL heading and background treatment
expected: SPECTRAL remains readable and does not create horizontal page overflow.

name: Reach official A$RAM destinations
description: Verifies visitors can reach the official A$RAM platforms.
steps: Scroll to the final A$RAM section
Use the Instagram, Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube links
expected: All four official destinations are presented as usable outbound links.
